{{recipe|Muc nhoi thit}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Vietnam|Cuisine of Vietnam]]

== Ingredients ==

=== Main dish ===
* 12 small [[Cookbook:Squid|squid]], cleaned, with tentacles removed and reserved
* 2 [[Cookbook:Spring Onion|spring onions]], cut into 2-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] lengths
* 2 dried black [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]], soaked in warm water for 30 minutes and quartered
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Fish Sauce|nước mắm]]
* 1 small carrot, [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 30 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] [[Cookbook:Bamboo Shoot|bamboo shoots]], drained and sliced
* 1 tablespoon of [[Cookbook:Nước maøu|Nước màu]]
* 2 cups chicken [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]

=== Stuffing ===
* 6 squid tentacles, finely chopped
* 250 grams pork fat, minced
* 2 cloves garlic, smashed
* 1 spring onions, finely chopped
* 2 dried black mushrooms, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes, stems removed, and finely chopped
* 1 teaspoon nước mắm
* 1 pinch sugar
* 1 pinch salt
* 1 pinch pepper

==Procedure==

=== Stuffing ===
# Combine chopped squid tentacles, minced pork fat, and garlic. 
# Add spring onion and mushrooms to the squid mixture, along with nước mắm, sugar, salt and pepper. 
# Stuff into the squid heads and secure the openings with toothpicks.

=== '''Main dish''' ===
# Place stuffed squid in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]] or clay pot along with the sliced carrot, bamboo shoots, spring onions, quartered mushrooms and soaking liquid, caramel sauce, chicken stock, and nước mắm.
# Place in a preheated 350 °F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]], and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for 20 minutes. 
# Serve in the pot accompanied by steamed rice.
